notes.title: Hotfix 1.06
notes.content:
This update includes following major bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed Vive XR Elite not working correctly
[*] Fixed not being able to build or upgrade Harbour and Airfield
[*] Fixed islands disappearing when switching between rooms.
[*] Fixed controllers being incorrectly aligned when Vive Hub is installed
[/list]
Various visual bugs have also been resolved.

tags.bug: - Fixed Vive XR Elite not working correctly
- Fixed not being able to build or upgrade Harbour and Airfield
- Fixed islands disappearing when switching between rooms.
- Fixed controllers being incorrectly aligned when Vive Hub is installed
